name: Prostitution
overview: Scripture clearly forbids prostitution, warning against causing others to engage in such sin, as seen in Leviticus 19:29 where prostituting a daughter is condemned to prevent widespread wickedness. Israelite women and men are explicitly prohibited from becoming prostitutes or sodomites (Deuteronomy 23:17). The New Testament reinforces sexual purity by condemning fornication and adultery, emphasizing the sanctity of marriage (Matthew 5:32; Galatians 5:19). Together, these verses reveal God's call for holiness and faithfulness in sexual conduct, rejecting all forms of sexual immorality including prostitution.
